recognize_zh: 整個視野布滿大小不一、圓形、被染成橘紅色的油滴，背景為淡紫色細顆粒，比例尺 50 µm；Oil Red O 陽性代表這些是中性脂質（VLDL/乳糜微粒），對應乳白色的高三酸甘油脂血漿。
features: Innumerable round, refractile droplets stained orange-red by Oil Red O
Marked size variation from fine dust-like droplets to globules roughly 10-15 um (50 um scale bar)
Droplets are free and evenly dispersed, not contained within cells
Pale lilac finely granular background from the counterstain with no cellular elements identified
describe_en: Oil Red O preparation of a lipemic fluid sample shows innumerable free, round lipid droplets of variable size, ranging from fine dust-like particles to globules of roughly 10-15 um, dispersed evenly over a pale granular background. The droplets stain orange-red, indicating neutral lipid (triglyceride-rich particles). No cells or cholesterol crystals are identified. Findings are consistent with triglyceride-rich lipoprotein particles (chylomicrons/VLDL) accounting for a milky, lactescent specimen, correlating with marked hypertriglyceridemia.

ddx.vs: Pseudochylous fluid contains notched rhomboid cholesterol crystals and high cholesterol with low triglycerides rather than Oil Red O-positive triglyceride droplets.

ddx.dx: Lipid-laden macrophages (e.g. lipoid pneumonia or fat embolism)
ddx.vs: In those settings the lipid is intracellular within foamy macrophages rather than free extracellular droplets.

ddx.dx: Propofol or parenteral lipid emulsion contamination
ddx.vs: Infused lipid emulsions produce similar Oil Red O-positive droplets, so infusion history and repeat sampling are needed to separate them from endogenous lipemia.
Bubbles and starch are unstained by Oil Red O, and starch shows a Maltese-cross pattern under polarized light.
